verdict.rationale: The axis applies because VirtualPostMail offers mail automation, but the pack shows no recurring or time-based scheduling. The 'automation rules' claim describes how incoming mail is handled, which is a one-off, event-triggered action rather than a recurring schedule. Zapier is a third-party platform, and the gated API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
